name: Logfire
summary: Traces and logs for Python and LLM apps.
description: Pydantic Logfire's hosted server queries traces and exceptions (US region).

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (logfire-us.pydantic.dev) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
